{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {df[df['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")

# Check revenue format
print(f"First 5 revenue values: {df['revenue'].head().tolist()}")

# Check if there are any paid_search and new customers
print(f"Unique combinations of channel and customer_segment: {df[['channel', 'customer_segment']].drop_duplicates().values.tolist()}")

# Check for QA orders
print(f"Number of rows with revenue == 999999.99: {df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0]}")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]}")"}
